Open a note and choose “Video tasks and outputs” → “Create explainer video”. Once materials are ready, send them to the computer or export a task package. The note needs organized text first; the app will explain how to prepare it. This connection does not offer text tasks.

Generate video and use cloud voice service?

The approved script will be sent to your configured voice service and then rendered on the computer. Voice generation may incur provider charges. If the result is unknown, it will not be retried automatically.
Approve voice generation and create video
Send note material and generate a storyboard?

The full Markdown text from this note, plus the audience and learning goal entered for this task, will be sent to the computer “%1$s”. It will then be sent to your configured model provider to generate a storyboard. The provider may charge fees. This confirms only this storyboard request.
Request stop for voice generation and rendering?

The computer will identify and stop this exact voice and rendering operation. Charges or cloud processing already incurred cannot be undone. It will show as stopped only after the computer confirms the stop.

This video task remains bound to its original connection, which was revoked or changed identity. When the network is available, refresh to check again. If its connection profile was deleted or its identity changed, create and verify a new connection using the app’s connection flow; that does not restore this task’s old binding. The old task remains as history. Create a new task to continue. Approval, voice generation, and rendering never happen automatically.
